data.description:
## Description
**What**: Update plugins/dso/agents/red-test-writer.md, plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/task-execution.md, and the fix-bug RED-phase prompt (path under plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/, resolved at implementation-plan) to invoke negative-examples-lookup.sh at task-start, inject retrieved examples under the label "## Project-specific learned patterns (advisory; not universal Rule 1-7+ authority)", cap at 3 examples per task, and omit the section entirely when 0 examples are returned (no empty block, no error).
**Why**: Closes the consumption side — test-writers actually see the learned lessons.
**Scope**:
- IN: three prompt edits; task-start lookup invocation; advisory label; 3-example cap; omit-on-empty behavior.
- OUT: the lookup script logic (draft-3); end-to-end fixtures (draft-8).

## Done Definitions

- All three named prompts (plugins/dso/agents/red-test-writer.md, plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/task-execution.md, and the fix-bug RED-phase prompt) invoke negative-examples-lookup.sh at task-start ← Satisfies: sc-4
- Retrieved examples are injected under the exact label "## Project-specific learned patterns (advisory; not universal Rule 1-7+ authority)" and capped at 3 examples per task ← Satisfies: sc-4
- When the lookup returns 0 examples the learned-patterns section is omitted entirely with no empty block and no error ← Satisfies: sc-4
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic ← Satisfies: sc-4

## Considerations

- [CrossEpic] EXTERNAL BLOCKER: d566-afa6 modifies the same three prompt files with Rule 6/7; merge-window protocol applies when both epics ship in overlapping sprints — coordinate edits, do not clobber d566's additions.
- [Risk] The advisory label must read verbatim so agents do not treat learned patterns as universal-rule authority.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a test-writing sub-agent, I want the three test-writer prompts to invoke the lookup at task-start and inject learned patterns under an advisory label, so that I distinguish project-specific lessons from the universal 7-rule standard.
